collection.description: A child asks why covering a small cooking flame makes it go out.

setup.text: (child) asks why covering a small cooking flame makes it go out.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (cook), a cook, explains that fire needs fuel, heat, and oxygen.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks why blowing sometimes strengthens a flame.

b1.text: (cook) shows the principle without letting (child) handle fire.

c1.text: (elder) recalls a fire proverb and explains its practical meaning.
